page.overview:
Who is Anmar bin Muntasir?

Anmar bin Muntasir was an Arabyan Vampire hailing from the city of Bel Aliad and a prominent member of the Lahmian Sisterhood.

The Lahmian Vampire Lord Neferata affectionately dubbed her as her "little leopard."

Anmar bin Muntasir was born in the caliph's harem in Bel Aliad, much like her brother.

At just sixteen years old , Anmar's life took a drastic turn when her brother seized the ancient Lahmian Vampire Neferata's impaled and paralyzed form as a trophy. Over ensuing months, Neferata communicated telepathically with Anmar during her secretive visits to Khaled's chambers, eventually persuading Khaled to remove the impaling lance from Neferata's body. Freed, Neferata transformed both Anmar and her brother into Vampires.
